limitations: No geographic or financial exclusion; all ten API companies retained.
Filed accounts are company-reported and unaudited. Registered active status does not prove current trading.
Latest financial periods differ. No total revenue, total current jobs, market growth, economic impact, investment ranking or IS-8 membership is inferred.
Website descriptions and client case studies are company claims, not independent validation.
Missing values are null; reported zero is preserved. Net assets are neither revenue nor market value.
Public funding search gaps remain visible; internal director financing is separate from external rounds.
No additional classification calls, paid services, account signup, publication or website implementation occurred.

research_queries.funding: Exact company-name searches with funding, investment or grant; Databotix also checked via Cheqdin.
research_queries.dealroom: Public indexed Dealroom company-profile searches covering all ten names and Cheqdin. No reliably matched profile found.
research_queries.grants: Indexed ukri.org checks for Databotix/Digitav/Digitive/Digniori, and gov.uk checks for RR Tech Solutions/Biztechsols/Retina Digital; not a complete grant-register search.
